Structural fixtures reproducing the JSON shape of the official DOGV backend
(https://dogv.gva.es/dogv-portal: /dogv/calendar, /dogv?date=, /disposicion/{id}),
observed live on 2026-10-15 (GitHub Actions probe runs 38717370600 and 38717723268).
Field names and formats are verbatim from those responses; energy texts are
abridged examples written for the test and must not be treated as real notices.
